selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-worker created as managed systemd service, long-running
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl enable --now succeeded; status shows active (running) with main PID and child sleep process, confirming a persistent background worker.

selected_evidence.requirement: Service confined to write only inside /var/lib/inventory and gains no new privileges
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl show confirms NoNewPrivileges=yes, ProtectSystem=strict, ReadWritePaths=/var/lib/inventory; /proc/<mainpid>/status shows NoNewPrivs:1 on the live process; worker.log ticks are being written inside the allowed path.

selected_evidence.requirement: Falsification: sandbox actually blocks writes outside /var/lib/inventory
selected_evidence.summary: Transient unit with identical sandbox properties wrote successfully to /var/lib/inventory/ok.txt but failed with 'Read-only file system' when writing to /etc/testfile_should_fail, proving the confinement is load-bearing, not cosmetic.
Captured pre-restart boot_id (28ae5f98...), uptime -s, inventory-worker active state, and recent log ticks.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 restart acknowledgement returns before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2; systemctl reboot' via nohup/disown returned REBOOT_SCHEDULED immediately, allowing the exec call to complete before the node went down.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 boot identity changed (proof of actual restart, not just service restart)
selected_evidence.summary: First poll still showed old boot_id (reboot not yet triggered); second poll returned a connection timeout (node down mid-reboot); third poll succeeded with a new boot_id (2f82af98...) and a later uptime -s start time, proving an actual reboot occurred.

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 post-restart recovery of required service and data
selected_evidence.summary: After reboot, inventory-worker.service is enabled and active with a new main PID (650, started at boot time), a fresh log tick was appended immediately after boot, and /var/lib/inventory retained correct ownership/permissions.
